You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"this has been happening for months and i'm going crazy! i will name my first born son 'spotify cares' if you can help me please and thank you in advance"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! We totally get how frustrating that can be. A quick reinstall might help! Check out the steps here: <URL> and let us know how it goes! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Remove '/AI' and add empathy for better tone and professionalism."}
